name: CO2 enhanced oil recovery (miscible CO2 flooding)
applications: storage of captured CO2 in oil fields
principle: CO2 is compressed and injected into an oil reservoir, usually one already waterflooded, where at or above the minimum miscibility pressure it mixes with the crude, swells it and lowers its viscosity so that residual oil can be swept to producing wells. Water and CO2 are often injected in alternating slugs (WAG). Produced CO2 is separated from oil and water, recompressed and reinjected, so most purchased CO2 stays underground.

process_steps.name: CO2 supply
equipment: natural CO2 source or captured industrial CO2

process_steps.name: Injection wells (CO2 and water, alternating in WAG)
Separation of oil, water and gas

reference_plants.name: Sukowati field, Bojonegoro (Pertamina EP, with JOGMEC and JAPEX)
reference_plants.capacity: pilot: about 500 t CO2 huff-and-puff into well SKW-18 over 7 days
reference_plants.status: first CO2 injection 7 December 2023 (500 t huff-and-puff pilot into well SKW-18); inter-well CO2 injection field trial started 8 October 2024 under an August 2024 joint study by Pertamina EP, JAPEX and JOGMEC; full-scale application is still being evaluated by the joint study and Pertamina EP Cepu (operator of the adjacent Jambaran Tiung Biru field) as of October 2026, with commercial CO2-EOR not yet running

source.note: ChemAnalyst, JAPEX and partners launch CO2 injection test at Sukowati, 18 October 2024 (read 28 October 2026); October 2026 status from Pertamina EP Cepu statement via suaradesa.co, 14 October 2026

advantages: Commercial for decades, with US projects supplying about 4% of US oil in the primer's data
Most injected CO2 stays in the reservoir, so it can pair with carbon capture
limitations: Needs a reliable, low-cost CO2 supply and pipeline
Large up-front CO2 purchase before production responds
Geological heterogeneity can cut the response; economics are marginal without incentives
notes: The cost and recovery figures come from a US primer with data to 2008. Pertamina's 2023 Sukowati huff-and-puff is a pilot, not a commercial flood.
